Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Panama taxes Panamanian-source income only: 0% to $11,000, 15% on the excess to $50,000, and $5,850 plus 25% above; there is no local income tax.
figures.applies: Citizens, residents and non-residents on Panamanian-source income

sources.said: Taxable income (USD*) Tax on column 1 (USD) Tax on excess (%) Over (column 1) Not over 0 11,000 0 0 11,000 50,000 0 15 50,000 5,850 25 * United States dollars Local income taxes There are no local taxes on income.

figures.finding: From 1 April 2025 the employee pays social security of 9.75% and the employer 13.25% (14.25% from 1 March 2027, 15.25% from 1 March 2029), with no ceiling; educational insurance adds 1.25% (employee) and 1.50% (employer).

sources.said: Effective 1 April 2025, social security tax is assessed at a rate of 9.75% for employees. For employers, contributions are subject to a progressive rate, starting at 13.25% from 1 April 2025, increasing to 14.25% from 1 March 2027, and reaching 15.25% from 1 March 2029 on wages … There is no maximum limit on the taxable amount. Educational insurance tax Educational insurance tax is assessed at the rate of 1.25% for employees and 1.50% for employers, on salaries and wages paid.

figures.finding: The employer withholds income tax from wages each month; an employee with one wage source and tax so withheld need not file; others pay estimated tax in three instalments (30 June, 30 September, 31 December).

sources.said: There is WHT from wages, salaries, and other remuneration for personal services. The total amount of the taxpayer's estimated income tax is payable annually in three equal instalments on 30 June, 30 September, and 31 December.

figures.finding: Tax on any income paid to a non-resident must be withheld by the payer; royalties and service fees paid abroad bear 25% on 50% of the remittance, an effective 12.5%.
figures.applies: Non-residents (performers' fees by the general rule; no artistes rule read)

sources.said: Non-residents are taxed only on income from Panamanian sources, and the tax on any type of income paid to a non-resident must be withheld by the payer.

Royalties and commissions on services paid to foreign entities are taxed through the application of the corresponding tax rate (i.e. 25%) over 50% of remittance under the concept of WHT (effective tax rate is 12.5%).

figures.finding: Royalties paid abroad bear the same effective 12.5% withholding; no special regime for a resident author was read.

sources.said: Recipient Dividends (%) Interest (%) Royalties (%) Foreign corporations 5/10/20* 12.5 12.5

figures.finding: Services bear ITBMS (Panama's VAT) at 7% (10% on hotel stays and alcohol, 15% on tobacco).

sources.said: The general tax rate is currently 7%. Alcoholic beverages and hotel accommodation are taxed at 10%, and tobacco and tobacco-derive

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; a return is due by 15 March of the following year.
figures.applies: Taxpayers other than single-source wage earners

sources.said: Tax returns are filed on a calendar-year basis. Tax returns All taxpayers, except employees having only one source of income from wages, salary, or other remuneration for personal services and whose monthly income tax is deducted by the employer, must file a tax return by 15 March of the following year.
